purpose: Falsify whether causal, confirmed-only per-action-dimension precision learning improves rank-four 16D action-effect adaptation over an exact strong W256 fast-memory baseline on stable and hidden-switch worlds, without an unacceptable memory/CPU cost.

family_definitions.A: P86-like original isotropic dyadic integer actions, t=48 confirmed 16D action/effect events and final novel withheld query, half worlds hidden regime change after t=24; SHA256-hashed deterministic generator
family_definitions.B: Same independent dyadic source and hidden shift, but coordinate j action integer a[j] is divided via integer // (2 ** (j % 4)) BEFORE both emitting action and computing causal_effect; no observational or oracle regime labels supplied to mechanism

source_policy: All FIT/CAL source births strictly after this frozen protocol commit; distinct P95 consumed cohorts not reused; prohibit creating OOD/NEGATIVE during this gate; record platform source SHA256 after first generation but never alter the frozen protocol/thresholds.

experimental.memory: W16x16 float32 online causal weights plus 16-feature diagonal precision float32 (272 learned persistent floats); optional int confirmed count disclosed
experimental.recurrence: For each confirmed (a,y), k=a/(||a||_2+epsilon) via torch.nn.functional.normalize; e=y-W@k; c=.99*c+k^2; g=k/sqrt(c+1e-4); g=g/(k*g).sum; W=.99*W + e outer g. Unconfirmed input must leave W and c bitwise unchanged. Query reads W@normalize(a) and never writes.
experimental.training: Only online confirmed action/consequence fitting; no offline model training or external first use.

controls: P86 W256 FIT-chosen 9-point eta[.5,1,1.5]×decay[.95,.99,1.0] conventional training-free controller selected by FIT only
W256 plus 16 inert allocated floats (272-float matched-capacity control)
source admission and missing/unconfirmed NaN negative

rules.fixed_no_tuning: Preconditioner formula, 1e-4 epsilon, eta=1, decay=.99 and all thresholds frozen before generating any source
rules.baseline_selection: Choose conventional eta/decay on FIT combined MSE separately per family only, evaluate on CAL unchanged

prospective_dev_acceptance.evidence_level: DEV only: even passing CAL is not an independent scientific pass

mandatory_final_regression: G5 pinned native TTT Windows+Ubuntu CPU
evaluation: Report all numerical metrics and platform timings in existing repo G4 artifact, including genuine negative outcomes; never reinterpret green engineering CI as scientific success.
